title: Import and export
description: Bring products in and out as CSV files.

export.heading: Export
export.description: Download all products, variants and barcodes as a CSV file. Opens correctly in Excel, including Mongolian text.
export.costsNote: The cost column is only included for users who may see costs.

template.heading: Template
template.description: An example file with the right columns. Do not rename the columns.

import.heading: Import
import.description: Pick a CSV file and check it first. If it is valid it is saved in one go; if not, nothing changes.
import.fileHint: UTF-8, up to 2 MB and 5000 rows.

help.heading: File rules
help.matching: A row updates the existing variant with the same SKU or barcode; otherwise it adds a new one.
help.blank: When updating, blank cells keep the current value. For new products blank cells take defaults.
help.grouping: Variants of one product are grouped by product_key (or by identical name). One row is one variant.
help.options: Options (colour, size…) need a name in option1_name… and values in option1….
help.barcodes: Separate several barcodes of one variant with “;”.
help.cost: Cost only applies to new variants.
help.category: Write a category as “Parent > Child” to be exact.

issues.heading: Problems
issues.summary: {count, plural, one {# problem found} other {# problems found}}. Fix them and check again.

ready: The file is valid and ready to import.
notCommitted: Nothing was saved because of the problems.
tooLargeClient: The file is larger than 2 MB.
readFailed: The file could not be read.

codes.invalidPlu: PLU must be up to 7 digits.
codes.duplicate: This code already belongs to another product.
codes.empty: The file is empty or has no data rows.
codes.tooLarge: The file is larger than 2 MB.
codes.badQuote: Unexpected text after a closing quote.
codes.columnCount: The row has a different number of values than the header.
codes.duplicateInFile: This code appears more than once in the file.
codes.ambiguousCategory: Several categories have this name. Use the full path (Parent > Child).
codes.ambiguousMatch: The row matches several different products.
